info.prompt: Bio-mechanical throne room interior: void black walls with neural lattice circuitry, skeletal gold buttresses supporting translucent dice that rotate toward a hit zone dripping molten amber, the player's cybernetic hands casting electric magenta shadows across frozen crystal keyboards as combo multipliers fracture the space into synaptic geometry shards—terminal overlays flicker with hacker code while the 120BPM heartbeat shakes gothic server vines.
